decisions.reason: The candidate describes generic access to commissions, tickets, and prizes without retaining any Big Block-specific attribute; it remains valid for the surviving Small Block.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already replaces the ticket and prize-draw copy with Small Block-only wording and leaves no stale Big Block-specific key.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes big_block_prize_copy; the remaining mission-page attributes stay valid.
Removing Big Block does not change the NFT mint number's referral-code identity, permanence, or display locations.
Automatic delivery to the winner wallet and Winners-page announcement remain applicable to the surviving Small Block prize flow.
The certificate email's reading action and confirmation contents do not depend on Big Block mechanics.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already changes the primary-mint pool contribution to $5 and removes the obsolete independence relationship with the eliminated Big Block counter.
The Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, and mint initiation behavior are unaffected by removal of Big Block.
Background creation and custody semantics of the fiat buyer's wallet remain unchanged.
The generic rule that active prize tickets transfer with the NFT remains valid for surviving Small Block tickets and contains no Big Block-specific state.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder allocation, $5 prize-pool allocation, and Small Block as the sole prize-pool recipient.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows the notification scope from Small and Big Blocks to Small Block only.
